name: Nakagawa Momo
source:
The beautiful leader of a crime syndicate she's on the run from the authorities who've tracked her to her current apartment. She has to get out fast so she tells her underling to find her a new place to stay.

He proposes that they live in the Family Planning Apartments under the assumed name of Nakagawa Momo （中川　もも）. Her true name is unknown.

Though she absolutely hates the thought of sex with someone beneath her it seems the robot is immune to bullets.
